title: The Ocean's Hidden World
desc: 深海又黑又冷，却住着会自己发光的鱼。

vocab.ex: Most of the ocean is far below the surface.
vocab.exZh: 海洋的大部分远在水面之下。

vocab.en: the force that presses on something
vocab.ex: Down there, the pressure is so great that it would crush a car.
vocab.exZh: 在那里，压力大到足以压扁一辆汽车。
许多生物在那里快乐地生活。

vocab.en: to travel through a place to learn about it
vocab.ex: Scientists are only beginning to explore this hidden world.
vocab.exZh: 科学家们才刚刚开始探索这个隐藏的世界。

vocab.ex: Their glow helps them find food in the dark.
vocab.exZh: 它们的光帮助它们在黑暗中寻找食物。

vocab.en: to stay alive in a difficult situation
vocab.ex: Other creatures survive by eating food that falls from above.
vocab.exZh: 另一些生物靠吃从上方落下的食物生存。

en: Most of the ocean is dark, cold, and far below the surface that we see from a boat.
Down there, the pressure is so great that it would crush a car, yet many creatures live there happily.
Scientists are only beginning to explore this hidden world.
zh: 海洋的大部分是黑暗、寒冷的，远在我们从船上看到的水面之下。
在那里，压力大到足以压扁一辆汽车，然而许多生物却在那里快乐地生活。
科学家们才刚刚开始探索这个隐藏的世界。

en: Some fish make their own light, and their glow helps them find food and talk to each other in the dark.
Other creatures survive by eating food that falls slowly from the bright water above.
Nothing is wasted down there, because food is hard to find.
zh: 有些鱼会自己发光，它们的光帮助它们在黑暗中寻找食物、彼此交流。
另一些生物靠吃从上方明亮水域缓缓落下的食物生存。
在那里什么都不会被浪费，因为食物很难找到。

en: New machines now let us explore deeper than ever before, without hurting the animals we meet.
Every trip brings back pictures of creatures that no one has seen before.
The deep ocean reminds us that our planet still has places left to discover.
zh: 新的机器现在让我们能探索到比以往更深的地方，同时不伤害遇到的动物。
每一次下潜都会带回以前从未有人见过的生物的照片。
深海提醒我们，我们的星球上仍然有待发现的地方。
